NOTE
**Ready for review**

The author split the single commit into three focused commits, added screenshots and videos for each UI change, and added tests for the auto-fill behavior. Since the feedback there have been 3 new pushes.

|     |         |
| --- | ------- |
| ✅  | Description now explains each change, with "Fixes #20316", a testing section and screenshots/videos |
| ✅  | Commits are split by concern: drag-and-drop fix, auto-fill, multi-file upload |
| ✅  | The linked issue has "help wanted" and is assigned to the author |
| ℹ️  | CI status isn't visible to the bot, so "all checks pass" is unverified. The description also shows no self-review checklist. |

**Reviewer:** laurynmm — gave the earlier feedback and is already following the PR. The multi-file design question (one request per file vs. a batch endpoint) is flagged by the author for maintainers to decide.

###### Next step

Remove "not ready", add "maintainer review", and assign laurynmm.

###### Reply

```quote
@laurynmm, could you review this?
```
